reference_sql:
WITH weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT week_start FROM calendar WHERE week_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-24' AND DATE '2025-03-03'),
units AS (SELECT ol.product_id, c.week_start, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN calendar c ON c.cal_date = CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) GROUP BY ol.product_id, c.week_start),
comp AS (SELECT cp.product_id, c.week_start, MIN(cp.price_eur) AS min_competitor_eur FROM competitor_prices cp JOIN calendar c ON c.cal_date = CAST(cp.observed_ts AS DATE) GROUP BY cp.product_id, c.week_start)
SELECT p.product_name, w.week_start, COALESCE(u.units, 0) AS units, k.min_competitor_eur
FROM products p
CROSS JOIN weeks w
LEFT JOIN units u ON u.product_id = p.product_id AND u.week_start = w.week_start
LEFT JOIN comp k ON k.product_id = p.product_id AND k.week_start = w.week_start
WHERE p.brand = 'Sonora'

solver.query:
WITH weeks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT week_start
  FROM calendar
  WHERE week_start >= DATE '2025-02-24' AND week_start <= DATE '2025-03-03'
), sold AS (
  SELECT l.product_id, CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) AS d, l.quantity
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
), chk AS (
  SELECT product_id, CAST(observed_ts AS DATE) AS d, price_eur
  FROM competitor_prices
), u AS (
  SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, w.week_start,
         (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity), 0) FROM sold s
           WHERE s.product_id = p.product_id AND s.d >= w.week_start AND s.d <= w.week_start + 6) AS units,
         (SELECT MIN(c.price_eur) FROM chk c
           WHERE c.product_id = p.product_id AND c.d >= w.week_start AND c.d <= w.week_start + 6) AS min_competitor_eur
  FROM products p
  CROSS JOIN weeks w
  WHERE p.brand = 'Sonora'
)
SELECT product_name, week_start, units, min_competitor_eur
FROM u
